comment: The Info docker's Name row reads the document's name, a star while unsaved, and 'autosaved' once a recovery copy holds the changes. The document is saved first, so dump 1 reads 'picture.sad' alone. A stroke makes dump 2 read 'picture.sad*'. The autosave is set to three seconds and Idle After to one, and after the wait dump 3 reads 'picture.sad*, autosaved' with the autosave's last_written set. A save makes dump 4 read the name alone again. Each dump's main window title starts with the row's name and star, as it read before this row. Each shot holds the Info docker at the left.
